fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2025-12-08 states that a dual-SIM handset of the complainant went missing after a brief push in a crowded stretch at Sevvanthi Park Shopping Complex, on 2025-12-06 around 08:30 hrs. Nandhini Sekar submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000014. The incident reportedly occurred on or near a bus bearing registration TN-01-ZZ-1053. A person named Logesh Subramani, associated with the number 9000000233, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Potentially relevant material referenced includes mobile phone records. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00273, as the mobile number 9000000233 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Handset reportedly snatched while the victim was using it near the roadside.
fields.Keywords: mobile theft, smartphone, morning, phone records, suspect, shopping complex, bus, mobile number
